subject: DPA + SCCs/HIPAA: VelocityPay onboarding — redlines & signature routing
messages:
From: Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@velocitypay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: VelocityPay onboarding — DPA, SCCs & HIPAA scoping

Hi Connor,

We're getting close to internal approvals to move Redwood into production for our card-processing flows. Legal asked me to get a firm plan from your side for the DPA + SCCs adoption and any HIPAA applicability notes (we touch limited PHI in a small reconciliation flow). Can you: 

- Confirm Redwood's default DPA language and whether you sign vendor DPA redlines
- Confirm approach to SCCs (execute standard EU SCCs or rely on your existing DPA with transfer mechanisms)
- Clarify HIPAA posture for the restricted flow (BAA required?)
- Provide an estimated timeline to complete redline negotiations and signature (target: 2 weeks)

I'm attaching our vendor questionnaire and a short list of data residency requirements. We also prefer e-sign (DocuSign) if acceptable.

Thanks — can we set a 30m sync if helpful.

Best,
Ava Lewis
Head of Partnerships, VelocityPay
[attachment: VelocityPay_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@velocitypay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: VelocityPay onboarding — DPA, SCCs & HIPAA scoping

Thanks Ava — appreciate the heads up and the questionnaire. Looping in Neha (Privacy lead) and Marissa (Legal ops) to own the DPA/redline flow. Quick plan: 

1) We'll review your questionnaire and return a redline by tomorrow EOD.
2) Neha will flag HIPAA applicability and any BAA discussion points.
3) If there are material retention or cross-border exceptions, we'll escalate to exec for sign-off (need ~48 hours for approvals).
4) We'll use DocuSign for signature once redlines are agreed.

If two weeks is the target, that should be doable assuming no new policy exceptions. Sending preliminary timeline + attachments now.

Connor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.docx]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: RE: VelocityPay onboarding — DPA, SCCs & HIPAA scoping

Connor / Marissa — I reviewed VelocityPay's questionnaire and drafted a redline. High-level summary and negotiation points below: 

- SCCs: We can execute the EU Standard Contractual Clauses as part of the DPA. Recommend embedding SCCs as an appendix rather than relying on a transfer mechanism; this keeps sign flow simple and aligns with our existing playbook.
- Retention: VelocityPay requests 48 months for transaction logs. Our default is 24 months. Legal recommends a compromise: 36 months with export-on-request and stronger deletion controls. This will need exec approval because it's outside the standard retention policy.
- HIPAA: Based on the description, this looks like limited PHI exposure in reconciliation. We do not sign a full BAA for low-volume incidental flows; propose an attestation clause describing controls and an operational contact for breach notification. If VelocityPay claims HIPAA-covered status for the flow, we'll escalate to SOC/Compliance for a BAA review (likely to lengthen timeline).
- Subprocessors & SCCs: Add explicit subprocessor list requirement and 30-day notice for changes.
- Evidence asks: They requested SOC 2 report and CAIQ output. We can provide SOC 2 SOC2-type-2 stub and a CAIQ export under NDA.

Attachments: VelocityPay_DPA_redline_20280719.docx (redline), Redline_Summary_20280720.xlsx (negotiation checklist). Please review and confirm final negotiables so I can prepare an exec memo if we need a 36-month retention exception.

Neha
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
[attachment: VelocityPay_DPA_redline_20280719.docx]
[attachment: Redline_Summary_20280720.xlsx]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@velocitypay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: VelocityPay onboarding — DPA, SCCs & HIPAA scoping

Hi Ava — thanks for the questionnaire. Attached is our proposed redline and a short summary of the negotiation points. Top-level proposals: 

- SCCs: we'll append the EU SCCs as an annex (no transfer mechanism gating).
- Retention: propose 36 months for transaction logs; Redwood will allow export and provide deletion support on request. This needs quick exec sign-off; Marissa will coordinate.
- HIPAA: provide attestation language; if VelocityPay insists on a BAA, we can escalate but it will extend timeline.
- Evidence: we'll provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and CAIQ extract under NDA.

If that sounds acceptable, can you confirm and we'll prepare a DocuSign envelope for signature routing (primary signers: VelocityPay COO + Redwood VP Ops)? Timeline: target signature by 2028-07-28.

Connor
[attachment: VelocityPay_DPA_redline_20280719.docx]
[attachment: Redline_Summary_20280720.xlsx]

From: VelocityPay Legal <legal@velocitypay.com>

Cc: Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@velocitypay.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 14:45:00 +0100
Subject: RE: VelocityPay onboarding — DPA, SCCs & HIPAA scoping

Connor,

Thanks for the redline. Our counsel pushed a counter with three asks that we'd like you to consider before we proceed to signature: 

1) Retention: asking to keep 48 months for transaction logs citing regulatory audits.
2) SOC 2 evidence: request for the full SOC 2 report (redacted) rather than a stub. Need confirmation of scope (in-scope systems).
3) Data residency: they asked whether data originating in the EU will be stored only in EU-region buckets; if not, a map of where backups and logs may replicate.

Attached is our counter-redline (we've kept comments). We can be flexible on the BAA stance — they will accept the attestation language for now but may reopen if proof of PHI handling increases.

If you can accept 36 months we can likely get sign-off faster; 48 months will require more escalations on our side.

Regards,
VelocityPay Legal
[attachment: VelocityPay_counter_redline_20280722.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: RE: VelocityPay onboarding — DPA, SCCs & HIPAA scoping — Exec approval + DocuSign

Team / Ava — quick update and final routing. Exec approved the 36-month retention exception for VelocityPay (approved by VP Revenue and VP Legal) provided the following are captured in the DPA: 

- 36 months retention for transaction logs, explicit export-on-request, and verification steps for deletion
- EU SCCs appended as Annex A; Redwood will provide subprocessor list and 30-day change notice
- HIPAA: attestation language only; we will escalate to BAA review if VelocityPay later confirms PHI coverage

I've created and sent the DocuSign envelope to the VelocityPay signers and Redwood's VP Ops. DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/sign/abc123

Marissa Cole
